title: Review: jmap-client crate
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — Two variants of ClientError wrapping the same type is a contributor footgun; StateChange missing #[non_exhaustive] is an API lock-in risk. Both are fixable before 1.0.
Idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — One bool parameter issue (hex_digit), one type inconsistency (StateChange using String vs newtypes). No ownership/lifetime issues, no unsafe, no gratuitous clones. Core patterns are solid.
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: SSE stream edge cases under adversarial servers (partial writes, unusual chunk boundaries). Uncertainty driven by: cannot exercise the streaming code path without a live HTTP server. Would raise confidence if: integration tests with a mock HTTP server exercising the UTF-8 split bug path.
Rust idiom confidence: 90% chance of missed issue. Least confident flags: none — I have read every line. Uncertainty driven by: interaction between JmapResponse serde and WsFrame deserialization I haven't traced fully.
